Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the American League was established in 1900 based on a search result snippet mentioning the Western League was renamed in 1900. This was a misinterpretation of the search results; the snippet actually stated the league changed its name in 1900 but developed into a major league in 1901. The Planner failed to distinguish between the renaming of the minor league (1900) and the establishment of the American League as a major league (1901), leading to an incorrect final answer of 1900 instead of the correct 1901. This error was then perpetuated in subsequent steps.
